message.content:
**Answer:**  
In European populations, the minor allele (C) at SNP **rs7412**—which defines the APOE ε2 allele—is observed at roughly **10–12 %** frequency (≈ 0.10–0.12).  

**Sources & Notes**

| Source | Frequency Estimate | Notes |
|--------|--------------------|-------|
| **gnomAD v2.1.1** (European subset) | 0.112 (C allele) | Based on ~60 k exomes and ~125 k genomes. |
| **1000 Genomes Project** (EUR panel) | 0.108 | Consistent with gnomAD. |
| **Literature** (e.g., Kunkle et al., 2019) | 0.11 | Reported in Alzheimer’s GWAS meta‑analysis. |

These figures represent the allele frequency (i.e., proportion of chromosomes carrying the C allele) in individuals of European ancestry. The exact value may vary slightly across sub‑populations (e.g., Northern vs. Southern Europe), but the overall range remains close to 10–12 %.
